marks.gloss_en: R' Yehuda (mishna, 5a): when [may they read early]? in a place where they enter [town] on Monday and Thursday; where they do not, it is read only in its time
the mishna (5a): a large city is any with ten batlanim; fewer -- it is a village
ומי אמר רב הכי? והאמר ... משמיה דרב: פורים שחל להיות בשבת ערב שבת זמנם. ערב שבת זמנם?! והא שבת זמנם! אלא לאו הכי קאמר: שלא בזמנם כזמנם -- even alone (h_lav_hachi_kaamar)
Rav (via Rav Yehuda son of Rav Shmuel bar Shilat): Purim that falls on Shabbat -- Shabbat eve is their time
לא, לענין מקרא מגילה בעשרה [לא איתמר]; ערב שבת זמנם -- לאפוקי מדרבי (= p_lehotzi_mirebbi)
no -- [it was not said] about reading with ten; 'Shabbat eve is their time' comes to exclude Rebbi, who said since the towns were moved they are moved to the day of assembly
but rejoicing is practised only in its time
Rav: the Megilla in its time is read even by an individual
the ten idlers [of the mishna] are ten idlers who are in the synagogue
one does not count days to make up years
one does not reckon hours to make up months
with regard to these [the Megilla's dates] they said: one advances and does not postpone
תשעה באב -- אקדומי פורענות לא מקדמי: the Ninth of Av is not advanced because one does not advance calamity
חגיגה -- משום דאכתי לא מטא זמן חיובייהו: not advanced because the time of its obligation has not yet arrived
הקהל -- משום דאכתי לא מטא זמן חיובייהו: not advanced because the time of its obligation has not yet arrived
but the time of the priests' wood offering ... is postponed and not advanced
Shmuel: the reason one advances and does not postpone -- the verse states 'and it shall not pass' (Esther 9:27)
דתנן, בית שמאי אומרים: ...אבל לא עולות -- only Beit Shammai forbid olot on yom tov, so only they need olat re'iyah postponed (kind svara: no SupportKind names דתנן)
the stam: whose view is it [on Rav Oshaya's reading]? Beit Shammai's
דתנן: מי שלא חג... חוגג והולך את כל הרגל כולו; עבר הרגל ולא חג אינו חייב באחריותו -- the whole festival, and no further
Rava: chagigah is postponed throughout the time of chagigah, and no further
דתנן: מודים שאם חל עצרת להיות בשבת שיום טבוח אחר השבת
Rav Ashi: chagigah and all the time of chagigah is postponed -- even Atzeret, which is one day, is postponed
the baraita: the festival peace-offering and all the time of the festival peace-offering -- one postpones
Rav Oshaya: this is what it says -- chagigah [is postponed] on Shabbat, and the burnt-offering of appearance even on yom tov, which is the time of chagigah
Beit Shammai: but not burnt-offerings
Rebbi planted a sapling on Purim
